sections.h2: Silverwood Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 55 residential sales closed in Silverwood (Chesapeake, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $445,000, close to the citywide median of $420,000, and homes took a median of 12 days to sell, faster than the citywide median of 18 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Silverwood sales closed between $346,750 and $492,500, or about $205 per square foot against $219 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($445,000, 27 sales) was about 3% lower than in the earlier 12 months ($460,000, 28 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Silverwood sales were in ZIP code 23321.

0% of the homes sold here were built in 2015 or later; across Chesapeake the figure is 24%. 56% of Silverwood homes went under contract within 14 days of listing, compared with 44% of Chesapeake sales overall. 82% of sales here were detached homes, versus 76% citywide.

sections.h2: When Silverwood Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in Silverwood were busiest in August (7 sales across the two years) and slowest in March (2 sales). Sold prices ran from $222,000 to $685,000, a spread of 3.1x between the lowest and highest sale. 82% of homes closed at or above list price and 2% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Silverwood
sections.html:
82% of the sales were detached homes and 18% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 2,018 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,674 to 2,418 square feet. 42% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1963 and 1986, with a median year built of 1977, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
